title: Gate 2 closes on machine evidence: preview.decide auto-approves a DEPLOYED preview receipt under a recorded opt-in
description:
SPIDR child B of parent task-d56a0cc5f6ae4dc88da5233a9702d9e6 ("One approval, then unattended"), split 2026-09-09 by architect-fa84777a. Sibling of child A (task-a47301ee3aa64866ba109d4c0283526f, the mapping + carried opt-ins leaf) and child C (task-24b68b05c865436ead05cd5ea375ff6f, Gate 3 / release.decide). This row is Gate 2 ONLY. It is the FIRST GATE that can go unattended, because unlike Gate 3 it waits on no unlanded evidence row - Gate 3's dossier prerequisite is still PLANNING with 0 commits.

OWNER DIRECTION driving the parent (2026-09-09): "we dont want moe-next to be stuck all the time for user approval we can approve the plan at the start but thats it". One human gate at plan/contract time; the rest unattended, with a human ABLE to intervene but not REQUIRED.

MEASURED AT HEAD 2026-09-09 by architect-fa84777a; re-measure before planning:
- `git grep -ln "evaluatePolicy|PolicyRiskTier|autoApprovalOptIns" -- apps/daemon/src/preview/**` returns NOTHING. The preview gate does not consult the policy engine at all today. This row BUILDS that consumption path; it is not flipping on a dark switch. The parent's description called the engine "dark", which is true of the two seams it names but understates this: there is no policy call at either gate.
- The decision function to CALL and NOT reimplement is packages/core/src/policy/policy-evaluation.ts assessTier at :150-166. R2/R3 return REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL with code HUMAN_ONLY_TIER (:155-158); a tier with no matching opt-in returns REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL with code AUTO_APPROVAL_NOT_OPTED_IN (:165). An opt-in matches only when `entry.action === action && tierRank(entry.tier) >= tierRank(tier)`.
- preview-contracts.ts:43 `PREVIEW_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND = "preview.decide"`; PREVIEW_DECISIONS is frozen at ["APPROVE","REJECT"] (:63).

THE DESIGN DECISION THAT KEEPS THIS ROW SMALL - do not rediscover it, and do not depart from it without reporting. There are TWO separate shapes and only one of them is a shared contract:
1. THE WIRE PAYLOAD is EXACT-ARITY. decodePreviewDecidePayload (preview-contracts.ts:258-282) demands APPROVE be exactly ["decision","previewRef"] (PREVIEW_APPROVE_PAYLOAD_KEYS :68) and refuses any extra key with PREVIEW_DECISION_INVALID. Adding provenance HERE would change a shared runtime contract and force all four GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST mirrors to rotate - the four-row job epic rail 1 describes. DO NOT DO THAT.
2. THE PERSISTED RECORD is DAEMON-LOCAL and versioned. preview-daemon-edge.ts:62 `PREVIEW_DECISION_VERSION = "moe-preview-decision/1"`, PREVIEW_DECISION_KEYS at :64, written at :255-260, read back by readPreviewDecision at :156-190 via exactPreviewRecord. MEASURED: `git grep -n "PREVIEW_DECISION_KEYS|PREVIEW_DECISION_VERSION|PreviewDecisionRecord" -- apps/control-room/** packages/control-room-client/** packages/contracts/**` returns NOTHING. Nothing outside apps/daemon pins this shape. PROVENANCE GOES HERE, and no digest mirror rotates.

MIGRATION HAZARD, name it in the plan. readPreviewDecision returns null when `record["version"] !== PREVIEW_DECISION_VERSION` (:170) and exactPreviewRecord enforces exact arity, so an optional key is not possible and a naive version bump makes every previously persisted decision unreadable. Recommended shape, to be verified not assumed: bump to "moe-preview-decision/2" with the provenance key ALWAYS present (null for a human decision, the opt-in's action and tier for an automatic one), and keep a read arm that still admits a /1 record by treating its provenance as null. An arm must prove a /1 record still reads back.

WHO SUBMITS THE AUTOMATIC DECISION. Do NOT widen the MCP allowlist and do NOT let an agent seat decide a gate. The automatic decision is taken SERVER-SIDE inside the daemon under the operator principal acting on a recorded opt-in, never as a wire command from a seat. Governor ruling 2026-09-06 (task-136cbab2, comment-b0d0a809c1a7445e91f03f83ea69329d) is binding: do NOT remove a kind from OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS - MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS is DERIVED from it, so a roster edit opens two fences in one line. If you find yourself editing a roster you have left the approved scope: stop and report.

A MANUAL REJECT WINS. If a human has recorded a REJECT for the preview, the automatic path must not overturn it, and the refusal carries a stable code asserted WITH its layer. The preview refusal map is CLOSED AT FOUR CODES (preview-contracts.ts comments at :283-292 state no fifth code is minted for a condition the preview vocabulary does not own). Prefer an existing code; if none fits, the correct move is to report rather than quietly widen a closed vocabulary.

OUT OF SCOPE, owned by siblings: the risk-class mapping and carried opt-ins (row A); anything under apps/daemon/src/release/ (row C); the end-to-end unattended journey arm (the parent). Do not widen POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS or edit packages/core/src/policy/.
definitionOfDone: preview.decide consults the policy engine: a production module under apps/daemon/src/preview/ calls evaluatePolicy from the @moe/core bare specifier and does NOT reimplement tier or opt-in logic; `git grep -n 'evaluatePolicy' -- apps/daemon/src/preview/` returns at least one non-test hit, quoted in the completion record.

An arm proves the AUTOMATIC APPROVE path: a DEPLOYED preview receipt, under a recorded R0 or R1 opt-in whose action equals PREVIEW_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND, is approved with NO human decision, and the persisted decision record NAMES the opt-in it acted under (action and tier), so a reviewer can tell an automatic approval from a human one. Assert the recorded provenance fields, not merely that the outcome was APPROVE.

An arm proves R2 and R3 are NOT auto-approved: the gate stays pending for a human and the refusal carries HUMAN_ONLY_TIER from evaluatePolicy, asserted with its layer. A separate arm asserts POLICY_AUTO_APPROVAL_TIERS still deep-equals ['R0','R1'] and that this row modified no file under packages/core/src/policy/.

An arm proves a recorded human REJECT WINS: with a manual REJECT already persisted and a valid R0 opt-in present, the automatic path does not overturn it and refuses with a stable code asserted together with its layer. Verify non-vacuity by mutating the precedence check in the production module and confirming this arm goes RED; prove the drill's restore by SHA256 equality against an out-of-tree backup whose path carries this task id, in a call separate from the restore.

The SHARED WIRE CONTRACT IS UNTOUCHED: PREVIEW_APPROVE_PAYLOAD_KEYS still deep-equals ['decision','previewRef'] and PREVIEW_REJECT_PAYLOAD_KEYS still deep-equals ['decision','findings','previewRef']; an arm asserts decodePreviewDecidePayload still refuses an APPROVE payload carrying any extra key with PREVIEW_DECISION_INVALID. A full-tree `git grep` of GENERATED_CONTRACT_DIGEST shows no mirror needed rotation, quoted in the completion record.

Persisted-record compatibility is proven, not assumed: an arm reads back a record written at the PREVIOUS PREVIEW_DECISION_VERSION and asserts it still decodes (with provenance absent or null), and another arm reads back a record at the new version with provenance present. Both assert the decoded field values, not merely that the read returned non-null.

The human-only fence is UNCHANGED: PREVIEW_DECIDE_COMMAND_KIND is still in OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS and still in MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS, and no agent seat or MCP tool can submit a gate decision. Assert BOTH directions per global rail 9, enumerating the served set from the dispatch seam rather than only from the roster constant.

pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test EXITS 0 with its `Test Files N passed` count line quoted and NONZERO, and pnpm typecheck exits 0. pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test is run and quoted as well, since apps/control-room is in none of the root vitest include, pnpm typecheck, or the daemon leg.
